objective: Create the safe PC cleanup audit package. This is design and inventory tooling only: no deletion, no local execution, no paid services. Define a structured audit schema, a discovery procedure, a read-only PowerShell inventory script that can later be run manually on Windows, and an Astra review packet. Update project memory/provenance. The audit script must never delete, uninstall, modify registry, stop services, or alter files.
constraints: No AI video inference on local PC
No cleanup deletion or uninstall actions
PowerShell script must be read-only and output an inventory report only
acceptance_criteria: All provenance-bearing filenames/metadata use gemini-3.1-flash-lite exactly.
Exact normalized path matching is the only way provenance_match can become true; no filename-only matching.
All active orchestrator folders and control files are KEEP_ACTIVE.
CANDIDATE_REVIEW_ONLY requires exact ledger/provenance match or containment under an explicitly supplied AgentOwnedCandidateRoot.
AgentOwnedCandidateRoots defaults empty; no arbitrary home/system scan occurs by default.
Script is non-destructive and default output is stdout; file output requires explicit OutputPath.
Canonical-file provenance uses modification events with actor/model, not contradictory created_by/model combinations.
Astra review packet remains pending and states the safety controls.
CURRENT_STATE and NEXT_ACTIONS reflect completed manual setup and Google Drive.
retry_reason: Pre-Astra safety gate found two remaining classification/provenance defects. Use a separate free worker-model quota to correct them before spending Astra review usage.
orchestrator_corrections: Use exact actual worker model gemini-3.1-flash-lite in all provenance-bearing filenames and metadata for this regenerated candidate.
The PowerShell script must perform provenance matching ONLY by exact normalized path. Remove any filename-only fallback such as comparing $file.Name to registry entries.

The active orchestrator folders .git, memory, tasks, docs, triggers, review_packets, schemas, scripts and root control files are KEEP_ACTIVE. Never classify current triggers or worker-result files inside the active project as cleanup candidates.
